title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a moneylender. However, tables turn when she loses her property, and they fall in love.

title: Iruvudellava Bittu
desc: Poorvi, an independent woman, leaves her family and boyfriend, Dev, due to her ego and self-conceit. Despite making several imprudent decisions, her life comes back on track after meeting Akash.

title: Raja Mahal
desc: Three college friends decide to open a resort. However, their lives change when they start experiencing paranormal activities in their resort.

title: Vedha
desc: A father and daughter embark on a killing spree in a bid to seek revenge against those who have wronged them. However, a police officer seeks to put an end to their murders.
